shortDescription: Elon Musk said Optimus humanoid robots and Cybercab autonomous taxis will account for most of Tesla's value. According to ChainCatcher, he also identified superintelligence, robotics, solar energy and large-scale space transportation as areas with potential for extraordinary economic scale.
